thag5.6:1.1: Atthāya vata me buddho nadiṃ Nerañjaraṃ agā, yassāhaṃ dhammaṃ sutvāna micchādiṭṭhiṃ vivajjayiṃ. || ||
thag5.6:2.1: yajiṃ uccāvace yaññe, aggihuttaṃ juhiṃ ahaṃ esā suddhīti maññanto andhabhūto puthujjano. || ||
thag5.6:3.1: diṭṭhigahaṇapakkhanno parāmāsena mohito asuddhiṃ maññisaṃ suddhiṃ andhabhūto aviddasu. || ||
thag5.6:4.1: micchādiṭṭhi pahīnā me, bhavā sabbe vidālitā, juhāmi dakkhiṇeyyaggiṃ, namassāmi tathāgataṃ. || ||
thag5.6:5.1: mohā sabbe pahīnā me, bhavataṇhā padālitā, vikkhīṇo jātisaṃsāro, n' atthi dāni punabbhavo 'ti. || || Nadīkassapo thero.
